```yaml
name: Merge Queue

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  merge-queue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Check for merge conflicts
      id: check-conflicts
      run: |
        git fetch origin
        git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main || echo "::set-output name=conflict::true"

    - name: Handle merge conflicts
      if: ${{ steps.check-conflicts.outputs.conflict == 'true' }}
      run: |
        echo "Merge conflicts detected. Please resolve them manually."
        exit 1

    - name: Allow opting out of request body deserialization for routes
      run: |
        # Add code here to allow opting out of request body deserialization for routes
        echo "Opting out of request body deserialization for routes implemented."

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add .
        git commit -m "Allow opting out of request body deserialization for routes"
        git push origin main
```
